intro: Tuvalu is a parliamentary democracy with the British monarch as head of state.

chapters.title: How it works
text: Parliament has 16 members and there are no political parties. Feleti Teo became prime minister in 2024.

chapters.title: Digital nation
text: Tuvalu is creating a digital copy of itself so its culture can survive even if the land is lost.
